case_results.wording: Whenever the design expands into another part of the system, the designer steps back: where does this part fit, and does its shape fit its intended use? The answer may be that the whole anatomy is redone, because this is a different animal.
The built-in default configuration is independent of this and is what gives the socket path on which the Configure signal arrives.
A flow woken for a permaflow is almost always a fresh flow; an old one is resumed only when the new input is literally the continuation of that topic.
A module may hold for every version of its topic, those not yet begun among them: its version field is the word all, and a flow bound to any version of the topic is given it.
